message: 🚨 ALERT: auth-service in CrashLoopBackOff. Authentication unavailable.
Auth is down. Pods are crash-looping. Let me check what deployed.

v4.1.0 added a new /healthz endpoint that checks DB connectivity. But the liveness probe has no initialDelaySeconds — it starts checking immediately on pod start, before the DB connection pool is ready.
That's my bad. I set up /healthz to check DB as a liveness probe. It should be a readiness probe. Liveness should only check if the process is alive.
Fixing now. Changing liveness to simple process check, adding initialDelaySeconds=30, and moving DB check to readiness probe.
Fixed. Auth pods are stable. All authentication working again. Total downtime: ~12 minutes.
